title: NORD-10 I/O device card: connector to the backplane

sources.document: Backwiring til NORD-10 (A/S Norsk Data-Elektronikk): connector specification list, connector lists per card position, signal code list
sources.note: Typed wiring list of the NORD-10 CPU crate. The connector lists of A22 and A25 were checked against the page images; the OCR of the other slot pages agrees with them pin for pin.

sources.document: NORD-10 drawings, sheet 2A50 SYNCHRONOUS MODEM BUFFER 1050 (1973), as read pin by pin in this repository (sheets/nord-10/2A50-sync-modem-buffer-1050.json, docs/2A50-reading.md)
sources.note: The names the card drawing uses (LEV10, IOXE, MC ...) differ from the backplane names (BINT10, BIOXE, BMCL ...); the pin numbers match.

sources.document: ND-06.008.01 NORD-10/S Reference Manual, Revision A
sources.note: Sections 3.3 (IOX), IDENT instruction, 4.1 (Input/Output hardware) and 4.1.3 (vectored interrupt identification). It refers to the NORD-10 Input/Output manual ND-06.004 for signal levels, definitions and timing; that manual was NOT found on this machine.

name.note: No NORD-10 document found names the card connector(s) (no A/B/C letters). The A/B/C plug letters are documented for NORD-100 modules only.

connectorsPerCard.note: The backwiring list has one connector per card position; whether the card has one physical connector or several is not stated.

pinNumbering.page: connector specification list, PDF page 3 ('Pin Range 0-99') and the connector lists
pinNumbering.note: No rows or sides are given; the column 'Pin Sequen.' reads 6 for every position and its meaning is open.

pinCount.note: From the pin range 0-99; the physical pin count is not stated.

pins.use: empty in the backwiring list for every I/O position (not bussed by this wiring)
BFQ1 on the 2A50 drawing (but empty in the backwiring list)

power.note: Power pins are not in the backwiring list; only the ones drawn on 2A50 are known (above). +5V pin open.

note: NORD-10/S manual section 4.1.1: 'Cable connectors are plugged directly into the backplane' and 'Device plugs are also to a common standard' (read). That the modem pins 81-95 of 2A50 are on the same 0-99 numbered connector as the bus pins is inferred from the shared numbering and that sentence; not proven.
